content_sections.text: The notice lists four components for selection, with marks as below. The total marks and the final merit method are not specified. Candidates are called for the computer practical exam category-wise in the ratio 1:10. A candidate absent from the exam is automatically disqualified. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Panchayat Raipur Accountant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.raipur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by District Panchayat Raipur for filling up vacancies under government contract schemes in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is लेखापाल (Accountant) under the approved District Panchayat Raipur recruitment notification scheme.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for the लेखापाल post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form is 15-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed B.Com. with a minimum of 55% marks (50% for ST candidates) from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is set between 21 and 35 years, with permissible age relaxations for local youth and reserved category candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 23,350 (एकमुश्त) as per the contract terms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the format, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form must be sent to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Raipur, via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection criteria?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic weightage from Higher Secondary and graduation marks, computer practical test, and relevant work experience in government rural development schemes.
